create_pipeline: create the Ollama Dynamic Vision Pipeline filter for dynamically processing images with a text-only model
configure_valves: configure the Pipeline Valves with vision_model, ollama_base_url, and model_to_override settings
run_inlet_filter: run the Pipeline inlet filter to intercept messages containing images and route them to a vision model
process_images_with_llava: process a list of images with text content using the Ollama chat API via the vision model
run_on_startup_hook: run the Pipeline on_startup lifecycle hook to initialize the filter
